changes.title: Harden CSV report cells against prefixed formulas
changes.text: CSV export now checks the first non-whitespace character before deciding whether a cell could be interpreted as a spreadsheet formula. Tab- and space-prefixed =,+,-,@ content is neutralized, while ordinary signed numeric values remain numeric. No report data, saved history or scoring is changed.

changes.title: Keep report export boundaries and row caps verified
changes.text: Report tests directly cover prefixed-formula neutralization and signed numbers. Retained test-only work also checks exact share limits, picker callbacks, UTC filenames, ordinary and grouped 1,000-row report caps and truthful omission counts.

changes.title: Retain TEST276 and complete report-audit evidence
changes.text: TEST276 remains the immediate previous compiled private candidate and TEST262 remains the latest owner publication. ReportRenderer, ReportBuilder and ReportExport review evidence is retained without implying publication, staging, owner-save install-over or physical-phone testing.
